name: Gun-Mage Adept
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Ranged Weapon Proficiency.

You gain proficiency with Ranged Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon;ranged weapon.

Cantrip.

You learn the Finger Guns cantrip.

Expanded Spell List.

The following spells are added to your spell list: Antiballistics Field, Ballistic Smite, Conjure Cannonball, Conjure Cover, Jam Weapon, Jethro's Instant Reload, and Perforating Shot.

Spells Prepared.

Choose a number of spells equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus from among those in the Expanded Spell List benefit. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell from the Expanded Spell List.

name: Iron Hero
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Underdog's Resolve.

When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your character level, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class|XPHB for that attack.

Vengeful Strike.

You have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 Hit Points|XPHB since the end of your last turn.

Heroic Intervention.

When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this Reaction|XPHB a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Marksman's Luck
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Flip Die.

Once per turn, when you roll for damage with a Ranged weapon, you can flip one of the damage dice over and use the number on the bottom. You can't use this ability on d4s. Note that for a balanced die, the top and bottom numbers add up to one more than the die's largest number.

Enhanced Critical.

When you score a Critical Hit|XPHB with a Ranged weapon, the target's Speed|XPHB is 0 until the end of its next turn.
